widgets.title: Credits
widgets.description: Credits held by users, what has been sold lately, and anything that needs an administrator.

permissions.name: credits:view
permissions.description: See every user's balance and ledger, purchases and the blocked-attempt log

permissions.name: credits:grant
permissions.description: Give promo credits to a user, and create and manage claim links

permissions.name: credits:adjust
permissions.description: Take credits away, reverse a spend, claw back a grant and write off what a user owes

permissions.name: credits:packs
permissions.description: Create, edit, price and disable the credit packs users can buy

permissions.name: credits:settings
permissions.description: Change the purchase limits, the refund policy and the other credits settings

permissions.name: credits:purchase
permissions.description: Buy credit packs for yourself. Every signed-in user holds this unless the site removes it

settings.name: refund_policy
settings.value: Credits have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for money or transferred to another account.
settings.description: Shown to the buyer beside the total before they pay, and recorded with each purchase. Say here when, and whether, unspent credits can be refunded

settings.name: tax_class
settings.description: The kempo-tax class a credit pack is taxed as, when kempo-tax is installed and enabled. A class name (digital, saas…) or a Stripe txcd_ code

settings.name: low_balance_threshold
settings.description: Fire the credits:low hook when a user's balance drops below this many credits — once each time it crosses. 0 turns it off

settings.name: purchase_limit_per_user
settings.description: Purchase attempts one user may start in an hour. Attempts over it are refused and logged

settings.name: purchase_limit_per_ip
settings.description: Purchase attempts one IP address may start in an hour, across every account using it

settings.name: purchase_limit_global
settings.description: Purchase attempts the whole site accepts in an hour. A ceiling for an attack spread across many accounts and addresses — raise it before a launch or a sale

settings.name: failed_payment_limit
settings.description: Declined payments one user, or one IP address, may have before further purchase attempts are refused for the cool-down

settings.name: failed_payment_cooldown_minutes
settings.description: How long purchases stay refused after too many declines, and how far back declines are counted

settings.name: trust_proxy
settings.description: Take the buyer's IP address from the X-Forwarded-For header. Turn on only when the site is behind a proxy you run (nginx, a load balancer, Cloudflare) — otherwise anyone can claim any address

groups.name: kempo-credits:support
groups.description: Looks up any user's balance and history and gives promo credits as goodwill, without being able to take credits away or change prices

groups.name: kempo-credits:administrator
groups.description: Everything: balances, grants and adjustments, packs and prices, claim links and the settings
